description: MainMobileActivity.java is an Android activity class that manages communication and capability detection between a mobile device and connected Wear OS devices. It checks if the Wear app is installed on remote devices, updates the UI accordingly, and provides functionality to open the Play Store on devices lacking the app.

classes.name: MainMobileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that manages interaction with connected Wear OS devices, including capability checks and UI updates based on device status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up UI elements, initializes the GoogleApiClient, and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listener and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Sets up capability listener and initiates device discovery.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates internal node sets and UI based on capability changes.

methods.name: findWearDevicesWithApp
methods.description: Queries devices that have the Wear app installed.

methods.name: findAllWearDevices
methods.description: Retrieves all connected Wear devices regardless of capability.

methods.name: verifyNodeAndUpdateUI
methods.description: Updates UI depending on connected devices and their app installation status.

methods.name: openPlayStoreOnWearDevicesWithoutApp
methods.description: Attempts to open Play Store on Wear devices without the app installed.
